funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; up to £3,000 for any stage, £3,001‑£8,000 for any stage, £8,001‑£20,000 for post‑doctoral level or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or about to start a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to help students begin or continue their postgraduate studies in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country undertaking research on 18th‑19th century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Support for travel and research on historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the 18th‑19th centuries.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK‑based master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding (fees and living costs) for a one‑year master’s degree, or split over two years for part‑time study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK‑based doctorate starting between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees may differ).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research, covering tuition and living costs over three years.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level researchers (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree (pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised experts).
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome, providing board, accommodation and an honorarium for research on British‑Italian topics.
